videos.title: Magento 2 Introduction
videos.description: This video introduces Magento's products and the fundamentals of the Magento 2 Open Source platform. It covers core concepts related to this e-commerce solution.

videos.title: Magento 2 Promotions Tutorial -  Cart, Coupons and Catalog Price Rules
videos.description: This video covers Magento 2 cart, coupon, and catalog price rules. It demonstrates the creation of promotions for various site interactions, from browsing to checkout.

videos.title: Magento 2 Tutorial - Import / Export with Attribute Modification
